valuation.method: Forward Non-GAAP EPS x justified P/E (FY2027 Non-GAAP diluted EPS viewed at the 12-month target date)

bear.driver: AI-native customer usage contraction persists and broader cloud optimization slows FY2027 revenue growth to ~16% with ~23% non-GAAP operating margin

base.driver: Core observability and cloud security sustain ~22% FY2027 revenue growth (~$5.49B) with ~26% non-GAAP operating margin

bull.driver: AI-native and enterprise workloads re-accelerate FY2027 revenue growth to ~26% with operating leverage lifting non-GAAP operating margin to ~28%

valuation.implied_by_close: At base FY2027 Non-GAAP EPS of $3.17, the $184.16 close implies 58.1x; the post-Q3 analyst-weighted target (~$276) implies 87.1x base EPS or $4.45 EPS at 62x.
valuation.sensitivity: One turn of P/E moves the base target by $3.17 (1.7 pp).
valuation.watch_metric: Q4 2026 revenue growth, AI-native customer usage stabilization, and initial FY2027 revenue and non-GAAP operating margin guidance.
valuation.next_disclosure: Q4 2026 earnings release and FY2027 outlook (expected February 2027).

analyst_notes: Following Datadog's Q3 2026 beat ($1.197B revenue, $0.81 non-GAAP EPS) and softer Q4 2026 guidance ($1.19B-$1.20B revenue, $0.69-$0.71 non-GAAP EPS) tied to its largest AI-native customer cutting usage to contract minimums, all six sampled analysts trimmed their 12-month price targets on November 5, 2026 while maintaining Buy/Outperform/Overweight ratings. The sampled post-earnings targets ($260-$300, average ~$276) imply ~50% upside vs. +6.7% in the independent base case, a ~43 pp gap driven by Street willingness to underwrite a higher forward multiple (~87x FY2027 base EPS) or faster multi-year AI/observability compounding.
